title: gastrolobium spectabile
intro: Gastrolobium spectabile, commonly known as the 'Poison Blossom', is a plant species native to Western Australia. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Gastrolobium spectabile include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
